ledger.x: c. 1625: Shyaam a-Mbul a Ngoong unites the Kuba chiefdoms. Infobox 'Established: 1625'; 'In approximately 1625, an individual from outside the area known as Shyaam a-Mbul a Ngoong' united the chiefdoms under one leader. The shape is a proxy of about 100,000 km2.
18th century: the Kuba expand south along the Kasai.
1884: the infobox ends the Kuba Kingdom.

certainty.note: No frontier is given beyond the three bounding rivers.
